description.describe_ch: 消費者行為的研究可以使我們可以觀察、分析消費趨勢與消費者的反應、行動、特徵，這不但可以使學生成為行銷的專業人員，更可以擴及其他生活的領域。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces Consumer Decision Process (CDP Model) in depth and how it affects on marketing mix strategy, branding and consonance.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 1. individual participation, group assignment, and attendance (30%) 2. Mid-term group oral presentation (20%) 3. In-class test (20%) 4. Term-report (30%)
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en: This course intends to foster students' basic understandings of consumer behavior and capability of marketing management. The grading policy includes the following facets that reflect not only individual learning proficiency but also group learning outcome. In addition, in the final week, we'll have a peer review to learn more information about individual participation. 1. individual participation and attendance (20%) 2. group assignment & oral presentation (30%) 3. Mid-Term Exam (20%) 4. Term-report (30%)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: This course is not an EMI course in this semester. However, as class participation accounts for a significant portion of the grade, it is recommended that students contribute to discussions whenever possible. All students will receive peer evaluation for his/her engagement in the course. For case studies, it is essential to complete the readings beforehand to facilitate subsequent classroom discussions.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en: The course requires group discussions, necessitating active participation from each student. To complete group mid-term report and term project, students should discussion and cooperate with their team members. Therefore, peer evaluation in the end of the semester will be very important in assessing a student's performance of group participation. In addition, students are encouraged to use English as the main communication language; however, mixing with some mandarin is acceptable in group discussion.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: The course requires group discussions, necessitating active participation from each student.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: Students' final projects must not plagiarize or use ChatGPT or any other AI tools for generation. Content of midterm and final reports will be checked for plagiarism, with a maximum allowable similarity percentage of 15%. The reports must clearly indicate the sources of information and reference. Plagiarism is a serious breach of academic trust. In schoolwork, our words and thoughts are the value of our work; so submitting someone else's work as our own is a form of theft. When you use someone else's words and ideas, whether by a famous author or a classmate, without acknowledging the source of those articles, words and ideas, you are plagiarizing. Original work is my bottom line, plagiarized work will receive a "0" or "fail" score.
